notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Momentary Blink.
description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
